text:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — we’re doing the AP-NORTHEAST3 cluster bring-up tomorrow 09:00 JST. This thread is for handoff notes, paging config, and any last-minute checks.

Priya: Thanks. Who owns paging once we cutover?

Morgan: Primary oncall is the AP-NORTHEAST rotation (see roster). Escalation: if pager not acknowledged in 5m -> oncall-2 (EU backup) -> ENG-SRE lead. Adding routing rules to PD now.

Alex: I pushed the initial Terraform module for the cluster to infra/ap-northeast3 branch. Commands for bootstrap:
```
# from infra/regions/ap-northeast3
terraform init
terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars
```
Make sure KMS key is set in env.

Jules: Network gotcha — upstream cloud provider only allows 500 ephemeral IPs per AZ; we need to set node-pooling and limit autoscaling to avoid IP exhaustion. Added a validation step in the runbook.

Tess: For GPU capacity, we have 8x A10g nodes reserved (32 GPUs) in the initial pool. Cost ops flagged on expected spend: ~ $32k/month in reserved + burst. Sam, we deferred spot burst to Phase 2 right?

Sam: Correct — spots will be Phase 2. Keep bursts disabled until we can validate node eviction behaviour with our Prometheus alerts.

OncallBot: [deploy-bot] deploy queued by Morgan: infra/ap-northeast3 branch. CI checks: pass.

Priya: Paging config changes I pushed to PD:
- ap-northeast3-cpu-high -> urgent -> 3min -> Paging policy A
- ap-northeast3-gpu-memory -> high -> 5min -> Paging policy A
- infra-network-outage -> critical -> 1min -> global-sre
Please review.

Alex: Validation checklist I recommend we run during handoff:
1) Control plane health (kube-apiserver, controller-manager)
2) GPU device plugin pods healthy on all nodes
3) KV cache warmup for common models (run small inference test)
4) Network egress + SNAT capacity under load
5) PD paging inject test for each policy
Run commands: `kubectl get cs,ds,po -A` and `kubectl describe node <node>` for device plugin warnings.

Jules: Add a step to validate image pull throughput — our region sits behind a proxy and we saw 429s last time. `curl` test to registry + compare to baseline.

Tess: Training request: please schedule a 30m oncall orientation at 11:00 JST after cutover for AP-NORTHEAST runbook walkthrough. Will cover paging steps, cost alerts, and quick mitigation playbook.

Morgan: Agree. I'll DM the oncall roster and drop the calendar invite. Also embedding the runbook link in PD actions: /runbooks/ap-northeast3-bootstrap.

Sam: Mitigations for common GPU issues to include in the runbook:
- GPU OOMs: cordon + drain node, restart pods with smaller batch sizes
- Device plugin crashloop: roll device-plugin daemonset with `--log-level=debug` and collect /var/log/nvidia*
- Kernel driver mismatch: fallback to older driver AMI (AMI id in runbook)

Priya: Escalation text snippets for PD messages (so pager contains TL;DR):
> "AP-NORTHEAST3: <alert_type> affecting <service>. Acknowledge and follow runbook /runbooks/ap-northeast3-bootstrap. If not resolved in 15m escalate to ENG-SRE lead."

OncallBot: [pagerduty] test alert sent to ap-northeast3-cpu-high at 1765432160 — acknowledged by Jules.

Jules: Got the test alert. Confirming PD actions open the runbook link as intended.

Morgan: Final checklist before handoff (short):
- [x] Terraform applied
- [x] Provider quotas confirmed with cloud partner
- [x] KMS and IAM roles set
- [x] Paging policies added to PD
- [x] Runbook link in PD actions
- [x] 11:00 JST oncall orientation scheduled

Tess: I'll record the orientation and drop notes in the runbook for future hires. Also adding a cost watch dashboard to console with tokenized burn rate alerts.

Alex: After cutover, please keep an eye on these Prom queries for 30m:
- GPU_utilization_mean
- pod_restart_rate{reason!="Evicted"}
- snat_usage_total
If anything looks off, escalate immediately.

Morgan: Thanks everyone. If nothing else, we'll meet tomorrow 09:00 JST in #eng-oncall for the cutover. :thumbsup:

Sam: one last note — I've added a small q/a section in the runbook for common network error codes we saw in EU clusters.

Priya: Perfect. See you all tomorrow.

(End of thread)
